_comment: This is the only file you need to edit to make the board yours.
It is committed to the repo and contains nothing secret. API keys live
Nothing in it is looked up against a database. The strings you write are
matched directly against the text of official notices, which is why it
works anywhere in New Zealand without anyone compiling a suburb list.
name: Morning Board
_latlon: Used only for the weather. Right-click a point in any map app.
_region: One of: northland auckland waikato 'bay of plenty' gisborne "hawke's bay" taranaki manawatu-whanganui wellington tasman nelson marlborough 'west coast' canterbury otago southland 'chatham islands'
_suburbs: Yours, plus the ones you border. A road stopped one suburb over still changes how you drive to work.
_streets: Exact street names. These produce the sharpest cards: 'on X, where you live'.
_proximity_floor: How close a place-specific notice must be to reach you. REGION = every land notice in your city (about 2.2 a week). SUBURB = your suburb and neighbours (0.8). STREET = your street only (0.5). National changes ignore this entirely.
_attributes: Things true of you that gate occupational notices. Without 'pig_farmer' you never see pig levy changes. Known: household, diesel_vehicle, sheep_beef_farmer, pig_farmer, managed_fund_member, young_children
